title: Shark FlexStyle Next-Gen IonCurl 5-in-1 Hair Styler, Curler & Dryer, HD840
features: NEXT-GEN ION-POWERED HAIR DRYER & MULTI-STYLER: Dries, styles, and creates bouncy, defined curls with powerful Coanda ion airflow—all without heat damage.
POWERFUL COANDA WRAP CURLING: Hassle-free curls in seconds. Stronger wrap force for bouncier, more defined curls.
THE IONCURL DIFFERENCE: Ion power and powerful airflow help dry and style hair faster than your usual routine, with no heat damage for healthier looking hair.
NEW AIRSET BUTTON: Double-tap to pause airflow mid-style or hold down for a burst of cool air that locks your look in place.
NOW WITH SCALP SHIELD MODE: Activate to instantly drop to a cooler, scalp-safe setting — designed to protect hair growth from excessive heat.
ULTRA-FAST HAIR DRYER, VERSATILE MULTI-STYLER: Dry and style with one tool. Simplify your routine without sacrificing style.
NO HEAT DAMAGE: Advanced airflow technology styles without causing heat damage.
